integrity: Analytical proof supplied; finite reproducibility checker corroborates formulas and placement rule but is not a proof of all-parameter statements.
scientific_limitations: Exact for normalized heat flow on the first three graph Fourier modes of a finite cycle, two distinct sites, and raw observations at times zero and t>0. The optimum is for the smallest singular value, not mean-square error or condition number. The continuous-angle optimum is relaxed; the finite-grid optimum uses neighboring angles. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp two-time heat-sampling stability on the first Fourier band of a cycle
